answer: A bonded reputation ledger stops fake identities from multiplying: every agent must lock a refundable stake before transacting, and each completed deal adds to a visible history no fresh alias can copy. A cheater spinning up a thousand sparrows pays the stake a thousand times, while honest agents escape the spiral of distrust by keeping one onyx identity whose record grows more valuable than any shortcut. Faking scales in cost; honesty compounds in reward.
